steps.text: i'm {companion}. i'll keep you company while you're here.
most of us carry one loud inner voice. here, you grow a second one. yours, in your own words.
talking to yourself as "you", the way you'd talk to a friend, makes hard moments lighter. that's where the name comes from.

items: there are no right answers here.
no streaks, ever. come back whenever you like.
this isn't therapy. it's a place to practice.

steps.text: what would you like me to call you?
want to find out how your inner voice tends to talk? it takes about two minutes.

grounding.idea: talking to yourself as "you" or by name reduces distress under stress
grounding.source: Kross et al., 2014, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
